response:
我会直接按你给出的最终约束处理：镜像里不 COPY 7GB 的 third_party/，但运行时通过 compose 把 CosyVoice 挂到 /app/third_party/CosyVoice，同时修复 Matcha-TTS 的构建顺序。

一个关键冲突我会按“构建不进镜像、运行时挂载进容器”来解：third_party/CosyVoice 最终在容器内路径存在，但来源是 volume，不是 Dockerfile 的 COPY。

按下面两个文件直接替换即可。这个版本不在 Dockerfile 里 COPY third_party/，而是在 docker-compose.yml 中把 third_party/CosyVoice 挂载到 /app/third_party/CosyVoice。

Dockerfile
dockerfile
FROM nvidia/cuda:12.6.0-runtime-ubuntu24.04

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
ENV PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1
ENV VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/venv
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:${PATH}"
ENV PYTHONPATH="/app:/app/third_party/CosyVoice:/app/third_party/CosyVoice/third_party/Matcha-TTS:${PYTHONPATH}"

WORKDIR /app

SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    python3 \
    python3-venv \
    python3-dev \
    python3-pip \
    build-essential \
    git \
    curl \
    ca-certificates \
    ffmpeg \
    sox \
    libsox-dev \
    libsndfile1 \
    libgomp1 \
    espeak-ng \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN python3 -m venv "${VIRTUAL_ENV}" \
    && pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Python 3.12 下先安装构建 Matcha-TTS 需要的基础包。
# 这里强制 numpy>=1.26，避免 matcha-tts / CosyVoice 里的 numpy==1.24.3 在 Python 3.12 下构建失败。
RUN pip install "numpy>=1.26,<2.0" Cython packaging

# 使用 --no-build-isolation，并用 --no-deps 避免 matcha-tts 的 setup.py 重新拉取 numpy==1.24.3。
RUN pip install --no-build-isolation --no-deps matcha-tts

# 安装项目依赖。
# 过滤掉 requirements.txt 里可能存在的 matcha-tts、Matcha-TTS、third_party 本地路径和 numpy==1.24.3。
COPY requirements.txt /tmp/requirements.txt

RUN grep -vE '(^[[:space:]]*$|^[[:space:]]*#|matcha-tts|Matcha-TTS|third_party|numpy==1\.24\.3)' /tmp/requirements.txt > /tmp/requirements.docker.txt \
    && pip install -r /tmp/requirements.docker.txt \
    && pip install "fastapi" "uvicorn[standard]"

# 只复制 PHS 后端源码，不复制 third_party。
COPY phs/ /app/phs/

# 运行时由 docker-compose volumes 挂载这些目录。
RUN mkdir -p \
    /app/third_party/CosyVoice \
    /app/runtime/models \
    /app/samples

EXPOSE 8080

CMD ["uvicorn", "phs.server:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8080"]
docker-compose.yml
YAML
services:
  phs:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: phs:cuda12.6-py312
    container_name: phs
    restart: unless-stopped

    gpus: all

    ports:
      - "8080:8080"

    environment:
      NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: all
      NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES: compute,utility
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
      PYTHONPATH: /app:/app/third_party/CosyVoice:/app/third_party/CosyVoice/third_party/Matcha-TTS

    volumes:
      - ./third_party/CosyVoice:/app/third_party/CosyVoice
      - ./runtime/models:/app/runtime/models
      - ./samples:/app/samples

    command:
      - uvicorn
      - phs.server:app
      - --host
      - 0.0.0.0
      - --port
      - "8080"

注意：Dockerfile 已经不 COPY third_party/，但如果项目根目录没有 .dockerignore，Docker 构建上下文仍可能把 7GB 的 third_party/ 发给 Docker daemon。实际构建时建议同时把 third_party/、runtime/models/、samples/ 加入 .dockerignore。
